transform.adaptation: ESA’s original square composition already fills the frame. Resized and encoded as WebP; no objects or structures added.

coordinates.units: fractions of full image width and height measured from the top and left pixel edges

sun.meaning: centre of the Sun-marked range rings in the registered ESA labelled companion

galacticCenter.meaning: nominal centre of the depicted bright nucleus; an approximate illustration anchor

registration.sunBasis: Published Sun label and concentric distance circles. Independent 2025-01-29 ESA companion points toward this area. The arrowhead itself is intentionally offset and was not used.
registration.coreBasis: ESA identifies the centre of the luminous bar/bulge. At 2100 px, intensity-weighted centres of the inner nucleus above 5 different brightness thresholds fall across x=1049.06…1050.14, y=1048.87…1049.47 in zero-based pixel-centre indices. There is no separately resolved Sagittarius A* point in this artwork.

sources.label: ESA Gaia, Solar System distance ~26,600 light-years (8.2 kpc)

NASA, approximate Milky Way diameter 100,000 light-years

scale.sizeNoteKo: 밝은 별 원반의 통상 지름은 약 10만 광년입니다. 드문 외곽 원반 별은 은하 중심에서 약 8만 5천 광년 너머에서도 확인됐습니다. 은하의 끝은 어떤 천체 집단을 기준으로 삼는지에 따라 달라집니다.

schematic.meaning: Independent geometrical diagram. The orientation is arbitrary. Do not transplant these normalized coordinates onto the reconstruction.
